_scheme: Names. Models: STRUCTURE[version][-variant]-STEPSK[-sSEED]. TX = decision at Space (stream Transformer, fixed window after the word); RV = reviser that may change a word once more words are typed; TR = one model that decides at Space and revises (full window, every word labelled). A recipe gets the next version (TR4) when it is adopted: better cell average than the 10k baseline beyond noise at the same steps, no cell worse beyond noise, the same in two seeds. Screening runs: THEME-NN-STEPSK[-sSEED], THEME = the EXPERIMENTS.md log they belong to (dir = log 7, data directions; mark = log 10, en_marked; reg = log 11, regression; tr4 = log 12, error analysis to TR4; amb = log 19, ambiguous English; scr = log 20, overnight 10k screen; siz = log 22, model size; wid = log 23, knobs on the wide model), NN = order in that log; what a run changes is in 'knobs' and its lineage in 'parent' (a list when it joins two runs), not in the name. STEPS: 6K / 10K / 17K / 51K / 102K training steps (10K = screening runs). knobs: E = en_marked (version, share), L = entry loss weight, S / A / N = switch / ambiguous-English / number-word line multipliers, K = ambiguous-Korean multiplier, J = English+particle augmentation rate (default 0.5), X = extra kmix lines (NUNCHI_KMIX_EXTRA), H = Shift-held typo rate (NUNCHI_SHIFT_P), T = keyboard typo rate (NUNCHI_TYPO_P, default 0.15), W = lower-case rate of English in Korean text (NUNCHI_LOWER_P), F = rate of joining two neighbouring words of different languages (NUNCHI_JOIN_P), seed. status: production = the model to ship (one); candidate = trained to replace it, not yet checked; experiment = a screening run; archived = kept for the record (why in brackets at the end of 'what'). Files: the name in lower case, '-' -> '_', '.pt', as at training time (renamed runs keep their files: k8_10k.pt is tr4-02-10K; TX4-51K and RV1-51K keep tx4_long.pt / rv1_long.pt: the app's ONNX files are named after them). old_name: earlier names, newest first (the 10k score files in experiments/logs/knobs/ and the run configs use the first). left / right: words of context before / after a word (null = whole input). split_threshold / act_threshold: tuned on the dev sets; missing = code defaults. nunchi/models.py loads a model by name from here. digits: own key ids for 0-9 (models trained on the v2/v3 pools that keep numbers); data: training pools (v1: numbers removed, v3: numbers kept, code-only web lines thinned); parent: the model(s) it changes; steps: training steps.
